name: Eastern mosquitofish
desc: A tiny generalist that eats zooplankton, insects, and detritus. Bass, catfish and bluegill eat it, and so do wading birds.
about: The eastern mosquitofish is a species of freshwater fish, closely related to the western mosquitofish, Gambusia affinis. It is a member of the family Poeciliidae of order Cyprinodontiformes.
